title: Phoenix Nirvana
next_chapter_hook: As the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor was seized by terror, Chen Ji's voice rang in his ear—'This is only the beginning.' At the same time, a shocking commotion came from the direction of the Holy Sect, as the sealed temporal rift cracked open completely.

text.content: The hidden pages of the Tianji Record unfurled completely before Chen Ji's eyes, the ancient inscription seemingly branding itself into his soul—'Phoenix Nirvana, reborn from flames, death is not death and life is not life, the way to break the局的 lies in: using death to scheme death.' A cold smile slowly curved at the corner of his lips. Seven hundred chapters of death ritual were precisely the perfect stage for his rebirth. Outside the window, the night was pitch-black, and Tianqing Sect's funeral bells had already rung for the third time. Chen Ji knew that the true game had just begun.

Seven days later, at the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena. Chen Ji's 'remains' were neatly arranged on the high platform—a broken martial technique manual, a rusted sword, and the gray outer robe he had worn for ten years. These items looked so pitiful under the sunlight, yet they drew countless fervent gazes from below. 'What inheritance can atrash possibly have?' someone sneered, 'It's just for appearances.' Before the words finished, a sharp gaze like a blade swept over, and the speaker immediately fell silent.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji is dead, no need to continue this play.' Han Lie stood beside the high platform with hands clasped behind his back, his black battle robe fluttering in the wind, eyes full of disdain. 'Today's distribution of spoils is merely to appease those loyal 'former subordinates' of his. I am here—who dares take even a needle or thread?'

text.content: In a corner of the martial arena, a young lord in plain white robes was leisurely playing with a folding fan in his hands. His features were seventy percent similar to Chen Ji's, yet held an additional composure and serenity, as if this闹剧 was merely an insignificant clown show. 'Han Lie...' he murmured softly, a hint of playfulness in his voice. 'Remember your arrogance today. The day of reckoning will come.'

choice.prompt: 'The distribution of spoils is underway, the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor is about to appear. What should you do now?'

choices.description: 'Continue to observe the game of various factions as a bystander, waiting for the best moment to strike'

text.content: The white-robed lord closed his folding fan, his gaze growing deeper. He quietly retreated to a shadowy corner at the very back of the crowd, where he could overlook everything while remaining unnoticed by others. The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's figure appeared on the high platform, his purple robes signifying noble status, yet the faint smile on his face sent an inexplicable chill through the air.

dialogue.content: 'Everyone, although Chen Ji is dead, the things he left behind will be fairly distributed by me.' The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's voice echoed through the martial arena. 'Bring the remains forward.' His gaze swept over Han Lie meaningfully. 'Young hero Han, if you have objections, feel free to speak directly.'

text.content: Just then, a servant hurried over and whispered a few words in the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's ear. The latter's expression changed slightly before returning to normal, and he announced loudly: 'Everyone, please wait. Someone has sent a 'gift'—claimed to be a personal item for me.' He waved his hand. 'Open the gift box first.'

choices.description: Seize the chaos to deliver the evidence box to the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, exposing him publicly in embarrassment

text.content: The white-robed lord took out an exquisite jade box from his sleeve, its lid engraved with a faint talisman—the mark of the Tianji Record. He lightly beckoned, and an invisible force lifted the jade box, passing through the crowd and landing silently at the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's feet. 'What is this?' The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor frowned and ordered it opened.

The moment the jade box opened, a golden light shot skyward, and everyone present clearly saw the contents inside—a pitch-black blood-colored token, and a yellowed letter. The four large characters 'Heaven's Eye of the Way' were赫然 engraved on the token! The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's face instantly turned as white as paper, his hands trembling violently. 'This... this is impossible...' he cried out, his voice full of terror and despair.

choices.description: The chaos is the best opportunity, search for the missing sister Chen Nian first
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best opportunity for revenge

text.content: While everyone's attention was focused on the high platform, the white-robed lord quietly turned and walked toward the forest behind the martial arena. His mind flashed with that vague premonition from the Tianji Record—Chen Nian's figure flickering in and out, as if obscured by some force. He had to find her; she was his only remaining family in this world. Passing through a bamboo grove, a hidden cave appeared before him, its entrance carved with strange talismans.

The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's hands trembled more and more violently. He never imagined that the blood-colored token he thought had long been destroyed would appear here. He猛地抬头, his gaze frantically scanning his surroundings. 'Who! Who's behind this!' His voice was sharp and shrill, completely devoid of his usual composure. The crowd below looked at each other in bewilderment. Han Lie frowned and stepped forward. 'Grand Tutor, what exactly happened?'

Just then, a voice so familiar it made the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's soul flee appeared beside his ear—soft yet clear, as if whispering by his side: 'Grand Tutor, long time no see.' It was Chen Ji's voice! Impossible! Chen Ji was already dead! He had personally watched him breathe his last! The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's pupils constricted sharply, his face changing from pallor white to ashen gray, beads of sweat rolling down from his forehead. 'Chen... Chen Ji...' His voice trembled unsteadily.

The atmosphere on the martial arena instantly froze. Everyone saw the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor suddenly stiffen in place, his expression dramatically changing, as if he had witnessed some indescribable terror. Some began whispering: 'What's wrong with the Grand Tutor?' 'What characters are engraved on that token?' 'Heaven's Eye of the Way... why does that name sound so creepy?' The white-robed lord stood at the very back of the crowd, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips, his folding fan gently swaying, as if watching a wonderful drama.

dialogue.content: 'Grand Tutor!' Han Lie's brow furrowed tightly, he strode forward wanting to examine the items in the jade box, but was forcefully pushed away by the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor. 'Don't touch it!' the Grand Tutor screamed, his eyes full of fear and madness. 'No one touch that thing!' His loss of composure was witnessed by everyone present. Those who had been eyeing the 'inheritance' now showed playful expressions. Han Lie coldly snorted, his gaze sweeping over the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's trembling back, thinking to himself: It seems this Grand Tutor has many secrets that cannot be见人.

choice.prompt: Evidence has been delivered, the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor has lost composure publicly. How should you conclude this revenge drama?

choices.description: Appear in your true form, personally expose the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor before everyone
choices.visible_cost: Expose the secret of not being dead

text.content: The white-robed lord slowly walked out of the crowd, his plain white robes gently swaying in the wind. His features gradually changed, and that face seventy percent similar to Chen Ji's finally fully revealed—it was Chen Ji himself! 'Grand Tutor, long time no see.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, each word like a heavy hammer striking the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's heart. 'Impossible!' The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor retreated repeatedly. 'You are dead! I watched you die myself!'

dialogue.content: 'Dead?' Chen Ji laughed lightly. 'Grand Tutor, you underestimate me too much. If I hadn't faked my death, how could I have uncovered all your deeds over these years?' He slowly walked toward the high platform, each step seemingly stepping on the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's heart. 'Do you still recognize this token? Back then, you made a pact with the Heaven's Eye of the Way, sacrificing my entire Chen family in exchange for glory and wealth... This debt, I have remembered for a long time.'

text.content: At these words, everyone was shocked. The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's face turned deathly pale, his lips trembling as he couldn't get words out. He finally realized that everything he had meticulously planned had long been seen through by this 'trash'. 'When did you...' Chen Ji interrupted him. 'Grand Tutor, no need to be nervous. This is only the beginning.' He turned to face the crowd. 'Everyone, today's events are merely the first step of Chen's revenge. If anyone wishes to settle accounts in the future, feel free to come anytime.'

choices.description: Continue to remain mysterious, letting enemies fall into fear of mutual suspicion
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance for face-to-face revenge
choices.visible_reward: Enemies will be trapped in long-term fear
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor may counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji did not appear, simply continuing to stand in the shadows, his gaze coldly watching the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's frantic appearance. What he wanted was precisely this effect—letting enemies suffer in fear, collapse in suspicion. 'Chen Ji is dead.' He murmured softly, a cruel arc curving at the corner of his mouth. 'But his soul will forever haunt you.' The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor seemed to sense something, suddenly turning around, his terrified gaze frantically scanning his surroundings, yet seeing nothing.

choices.description: Evidence has been delivered, goal achieved, take the opportunity to leave and start new arrangements
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself, start the imperial court political storyline

text.content: Chen Ji quietly withdrew from the martial arena, his figure disappearing into the bustling crowd. He knew that today's events would spread throughout the entire imperial dynasty, and the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's doom was not far off. But this was merely the beginning; he still needed more arrangements to completely trample his enemies into the abyss. The opening of the imperial court political storyline meant he would enter an even more complex and dangerous chess game. But for Chen Ji, the more complex the chess game, the more excited he became.

The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor finally came to his senses. He fiercely tore the yellowed letter into pieces, screaming: 'Someone! Search for me! Dig three feet deep and find that evil spawn!' However, the gaze of everyone in the martial arena had already changed; it was a tacit understanding of scrutiny and playfulness. The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's connection with the Heaven's Eye of the Way—this news spread like wildfire through the crowd. Han Lie withdrew his examining gaze, thinking to himself: It seems the waters of this imperial dynasty run much deeper than he had imagined.

At the same time, in the northern border of the imperial dynasty, the sky in the direction of the Holy Sect suddenly cracked open a huge fissure. The pitch-black rift emanated an suffocating ancient aura, as if some ancient and terrifying existence was awakening. Was that a call from the Heavenly Way, or an omen of the apocalypse? Chen Ji stood on a distant mountain peak, his gaze deep and profound as he gazed at that pillar of black energy shooting upward. His Tianji Record trembled slightly, as if warning him of something. 'Chapter seven hundred...' he murmured softly. 'The wheel of fate has already begun to turn.'
